headlines.title: McDonald's still a tasty pick for investors, market expert says
headlines.summary: STORY: McDonald's last week missed U.S. sales growth expectations for the second quarter, blaming execution lapses that blunted its value push aimed at lower-income consumers who have been cutting back restaurant spending. The fast-food chain's shares are down more than 10% in 2026. Still, Miller has faith that the burger giant will always find a way to bounce back. "When you think about McDonald's and you look at the history, it's a company that actually has quietly and regularly innovated," she said. "I liken it a little bit to the arc we're going through with AI. We're asking, 'Can traditional software pivot, embrace new technology, new tastes, and move forward?' McDonald's has proven time and time again, while its reputation is for the value meal, they keep adjusting their menu to America's tastes. And I'm very confident they will continue to do that.

headlines.title: McDonald's Pushes 50,000-Store Goal to 2028: Is It Slowing Growth?
headlines.summary: MCD is pushing its 50,000-store goal to 2028 as U.S. traffic softens, but disciplined expansion and 2,600 planned 2026 openings support growth.

headlines.title: McDonald’s is getting into the energy game with Red Bull
headlines.summary: The fast-food giant will begin selling Red Bull Dragonberry Energizer starting on Aug. 17, as well as a new kind of dirty soda.

description: McDonald's Corporation owns, operates, and franchises restaurants under the McDonald's brand in the United States and internationally. It offers food and beverages, including hamburgers and cheeseburgers, various chicken sandwiches, fries, shakes, frozen desserts, sundaes, soft serve cones, cookies, pies, soft drinks, coffee, and other beverages; and full or limited breakfast, as well as sells various other products during limited-time promotions. The company owns and operates franchised restaurants under various structures, including conventional franchise, developmental license, or affiliate. McDonald's Corporation was founded in 1940 and is based in Chicago, Illinois.
